statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the maximum, over all length-n integer arrays y such that y[i] >= flowers[i] for every i with 0 <= i < n and sum_{i=0}^{n-1}(y[i]-flowers[i]) <= newFlowers, of C(y)*full + M(y)*partial, where C(y) = number of indices i with 0 <= i < n and y[i] >= target, and M(y) = 0 if C(y)=n, and otherwise M(y) = min{ y[i] | 0 <= i < n and y[i] < target }. The set of feasible y is nonempty because y=flowers is feasible.
preconditions: Let n = len(flowers). 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= flowers[i] <= 100000; 0 <= newFlowers <= 10000000000; 1 <= target <= 100000; 1 <= full <= 100000; 1 <= partial <= 100000. All input values are within the signed 64-bit range.
